annotations.title: Check if eSIM plans cover a country

description: Check whether a country is covered, plan by plan: for example, does the Europe eSIM cover France or Turkey? Regional plans can leave countries out, so a destination's country list is not every plan's coverage. Returns, per plan, covered yes / no / not published, with name, validity and price in USD, and a one-line summary such as "Covered by 2 of 7 Europe plans". Leave destination out to find every destination that includes the country (its own page first, then regional plans).

country.description: The country to check: two-letter ISO code (FR) or its name in any site language (France, Francia, Frankreich).

destination.description: Destination slug or name whose plans to check, for example europe. Leave out to check every destination.

locale.description: Language for plan names, destination names and page links: en, es, de, fr, pt or he. Default en.

name: check_coverage
